title: Spanish White Bean Soup with Chorizo and Kale
summary: A hearty Spanish-style soup with smoky chorizo, creamy white beans, and tender kale. It’s savoury, warming, and ideal for a satisfying lunch.

ingredients.name: canned white beans, drained and rinsed
kale, stems removed and leaves chopped

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the sliced chorizo and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until it releases its oil and starts to brown.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until softened. Stir in the garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the beans and water. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently for 12 to 15 minutes so the flavours combine and the broth becomes slightly creamy from the beans.
Add the kale and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until wilted but still bright green. Season with salt and black pepper.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.
